notes: There is no CLAUDE.md; README.md is the project's guide (Security and Development sections). By design: every .env value is optional; without APP_PASSWORD the app is open to anyone who can reach it (meant for a LAN or VPN); with it, sign-up pages, the Briefing Room, mission downloads and the DCS server hook stay open, and their links are hard to guess but not secret. Third-party mission scripts, beacon data and fonts are downloaded by tools/fetch_vendor.py at pinned commits with SHA-256 checks; vendor/ is not in git. The image runs gunicorn as the unprivileged app user after docker-entrypoint.sh fixes volume ownership. The Windows app (windows/, PyInstaller, Inno Setup) is released by .github/workflows/release.yml on v*.*.* tags. Tests: python -m tests.api, python -m tests.smoke --quick (both inside the image), luac5.1 -p on dcs-hook/ and the dumped mission Lua, and eslint on app/static (both in tool images from tests/tools/). On the Box the live app is not reachable; it runs on a separate Live Host. A Release is the GitHub release release.yml makes with the Windows app when the v<version> tag is pushed (the release key here, kind github). The live app is the Windows app on a Windows VM, updated with that installer; it never runs as a container (the Owner, 2026-11-17). The Docker image is for the tests on the Box and for anyone self-hosting.
